item.title: Luckey quarry owners file for dismissal of ‘sham’ eminent-domain case
item.description: LUCKEY, Ohio — The owners of a quarry are looking to dismiss Luckey’s attempt to take land via eminent domain, calling it a “complete sham” with “calculated, continuous, and shocking misrepresentations” by village officials.

item.title: Northwest Ohio is the 'gateway to birding nirvana,' advocate tells Rotarians
item.description: We’re not just singing the warbler’s praise when we say this: Kim Kaufman gets excited about birds.

item.title: Maumee high schoolers share human trafficking awareness with peers
item.description: A small group of Maumee High School students spoke to fellow students about human trafficking and called on them to look out for red flags and seek help from a trusted adult if they see any.

item.title: Pistons aren't deterred by a 4-game slide as their East lead starts eroding a bit
item.description: MIAMI — A week ago, the Detroit Pistons were flying high. Winners in eight of their last nine games and 5½ games clear of Boston in the Eastern Conference, they looked well on their way to becoming a No. 1 seed.

item.title: AI company Anthropic sues Trump administration seeking to undo 'supply chain risk' designation
item.description: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is suing to stop the Trump administration from enforcing what it calls an “unlawful campaign of retaliation” over its refusal to allow unrestricted military use of its technology.

item.title: To the editor: Time to let ‘iconic’ monument go
item.description: The Ohio Electric Railroad Bridge was built in 1908. At the time, it stood as the longest and largest earth-filled concrete bridge in the world. It connected Lucas and Wood counties through Waterville.

item.title: Editorial: RGP makes case
item.description: Northwest Ohio is perfect for large-scale data centers, according to the Regional Growth Partnership, which devoted its annual meeting last week to making the case to overcome the opposition.

item.title: BGSU football spring practice: 3 storylines and how they might turn out
item.description: BOWLING GREEN — The Bowling Green State University football team’s second year under head coach Eddie George includes a revamped coaching staff and plenty of new faces on the roster, as the Falcons head into spring practice on Tuesday.

item.title: James Harden scores 21, joins 29,000-point club in Cavaliers' 115-101 win over 76ers
item.description: CLEVELAND — James Harden scored 21 points to become the ninth player in NBA history with more than 29,000 career points, Keon Ellis added 19 off the bench, and the Cleveland Cavaliers cruised to a 115-101 victory over the short-handed Philadelphia 76ers on Monday night.

item.title: Men who brought explosives to NYC protest cited Islamic State as inspiration, complaint says
item.description: NEW YORK — Two men who brought explosives to a far-right protest outside New York City's mayoral mansion said they were inspired by the Islamic State extremist group, according to a court complaint.
